correctness.rationale: A local-algebra unit argument reduces every nontrivial zero-product pair to beta-orthogonality in V, which forces restriction b=lambda beta by a field-independent linear-functional kernel argument for d>=2. Cross coefficients are unconstrained. Multiplication-factor and symmetry conditions follow by coefficient comparison; determinant is up to sign c e lambda^d det(beta). Standalone finite checks construct all zero-product pairs and all parameters for (p,d)=(2,2),(3,2),(2,3); these checks do not substitute for the general proof.

value.rationale: For the natural infinite family of graded Artinian Gorenstein rings of Hilbert vector (1,d,1), the universal zero-product tensor quotient has a complete, exact invariant. The unrestricted obstruction grows as d+2 but the symmetric obstruction remains precisely one-dimensional; in the nondegenerate symmetric setting there is a sharp F2 exception. This completes an otherwise qualitative local-algebra non-determination phenomenon and gives the exact finite-field census independent of beta type.
